name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form; accurately describes the field-map treasure/gold/event-tile interaction handler. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching its own or a data address). No domain ID to preserve in the name. Keep.
purpose: Field-map treasure/gold/event-tile interaction handler: when the active unit confirms on a cursor tile whose terrain attribute has an event bit (0x20/0x60) set and that has not yet been consumed, it runs the open dialog, and on YES grants the tile's payload (item / gold / chapter-scripted event).
logic_summary: Reads the tile attribute at the cursor world position -> 16-bit tile index (out+2) and attr byte (out+4). Gates: (attr & 0x60)==0 returns; consumed_flags[idx]!=0 returns. Clears keyboard, loads the actor's chapter portrait, shows the opening dialog (bit 0x20 -> text 0x1A5 else 0x1AC), paints portrait and runs the typewriter loop; YES = (result==1 && cursor_idx==0). On YES it plays SFX 0xC and reads the 3-byte tile_event_data_table entry (type at +0x53, value word at +0x54): type 0 = ITEM (set item-name dialog id = value+0xB5, show found-item dialog, add to inventory; on inventory-full -1 run the full-bag swap UI: prompt 0x1A7, on YES open the inventory-selection modal, swap the chosen slot for the picked item and write the swapped-out id back into the tile entry, show 0x1A9; else 0x1A8; on not-full mark consumed and tick animations); type 1 = GOLD (stage amount in last_action_value, choose found-gold/empty dialog by bit 0x20 and amount!=0, show, then party_total_gold += staged value, mark consumed, tick animations); type other = EVENT (delay, close, call the post-action consequence handler table indexed by the value word). The NO branch shows the cancel dialog 0x19C and closes.
